info.title: Palace HTTP API
info.description: Owner-scoped Palace API. Schema describes wire structure, not authorization or transactional guarantees. Body limits use injected ImportLimits (default raw history 8 MiB); HTTP limit is bytes * 6 + 64 KiB. UTF-8 byte limits, nonblank strings and canonical cursor upper bounds are enforced by the server. Native extractor errors may be text/plain. No deployment credentials or environment metadata are included.

ConversationMoment.description: A conversation moment is one path of a conversation tree.

excerpt.description: Up to the first two messages of the path as plain text, each at most 120 characters plus an ellipsis.

id.description: Moment id, equal to the path id.

message_count.description: Messages from the root to the end of this path.

occurred_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds selected by the user.

created_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds assigned by the database.

occurred_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds selected by the user.

original_link.description: A controlled external link, never fetched by the server.

title.description: The title of this source session; other paths of the tree have their own.

updated_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds assigned by the database.

Cursor.description: Canonical decimal string in 0..=9223372036854775807; the domain checks the numeric upper bound.

login.description: /auth/login for authentication_required; the empty string for other errors. Always present.

FileImport.description: A multipart transport view of TextImport; each metadata part is UTF-8 text (at most 1024 bytes).

history.description: Raw history bytes; default limit 8 MiB. File or text part accepted; filename/MIME ignored.

occurred_at.description: Text parsed as i64 epoch milliseconds in -62135596800000..=253402300799999.

session_id.description: 1..512 UTF-8 bytes; a single literal source identity segment.

logged_out.description: True after the local revocation has committed, including when external revocation is pending.

created_order.description: Ordering integer, not a timestamp; i64 values are not generally lossless JS numbers.

parent_message_id.description: Always present; root messages carry null.

Moment.description: One timeline entry; `kind` selects the card fields that follow.

history.description: Original JSON array text, with the same limits as TextImport.history.

idempotency_key.description: Nonblank; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, scoped to the owner.

occurred_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds selected by the user.

session_id.description: 1..512 UTF-8 bytes; same source identity validation as initial import.

title.description: Title of the new path. Nonblank after trimming; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

source.description: Source of the whole conversation; it cascades to every path.

title.description: Title of the addressed path. Nonblank after trimming; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; no normalization.

Record.description: Independent opaque records; this protocol cannot modify imported conversation trees.

body.description: Required but accepts any JSON value, including null; no domain object shape is imposed.

updatedAt.description: Client Unix epoch milliseconds; full i64 range, not guaranteed lossless in JS number.

TextImport.description: Original history JSON is a string here, not an embedded message array.

history.description:
Nonempty role/content array encoded as text. Default limits: 8 MiB, 10000 messages,
1 MiB per content, depth 32. Extra message fields are ignored; content is preserved.

idempotency_key.description: Nonblank after trimming; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, scoped to the owner.

occurred_at.description: User-selected Unix epoch milliseconds, calendar years 0001 through 9999.

session_id.description: 1..512 UTF-8 bytes; one source path segment, no whitespace, controls or /\\?#%:.

title.description: Nonblank after trimming; preserve the original value; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

history.description: Full historical prefix plus appended messages as original JSON text; TextImport limits apply.
